# Rules for the VU family's fixtures (FIX-P4a): a texture a VU draw samples is
# `opaque` (alpha 128 on every texel), so the alpha plan (rd_alpha_plan.c)
# decides an alpha-tested VU draw's pixels at once and plans the one pass the
# draw merge and code 36's fused pair need (a texture of alpha 0 to 255 decides
# nothing: two passes, every run of one draw and every pair kept apart); the
# default rules otherwise
glyphs     sheet
ramp       r8
date_split date
opaque     vu
alpha_ramp ate
bright     additive
gradient   abe
checker    sprite
grey       unused
checker
